g.text: Box Office: ‘You Can See Everything’ Becomes Second-Biggest Doc Ever in North America With $80 Million ◆ Cineplex Boards Sanfic Title ‘La Residencia’ From ‘Algo Azul’ Director Mariel García Spooner ◆ Box Office: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Roars With $31 Million Debut, ‘Cat in the Hat’ Fizzles With $20 Million ◆ How to Watch Trump’s ’60 Minutes’ Interview Online ◆ Taiwan’s Content Agency and Partners Put $180 Million Into 27 Projects, From an ‘Our Blues’ Remake to an Off-Broadway Musical ◆ ‘SNL’ Weekend Update Brutally Roasts Elon Musk Over ‘Epic’ Midterms Defeat ◆
